t: For necessary expenses of the Executive Residence at the White House, $13,081,000, to be expended and accounted for as provided by 3 U.S.C. 105, 109, 110, and 112–114.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation for the expenses of the Executive Residence at the White House, with spending and accounting governed by cited statutory provisions. There is no tempting reading here: no party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given any right to object or sue. No comment period, rulemaking, hearing, or advisory body is involved.
fable.s: For necessary expenses of the Executive Residence at the White House, $13,081,000, to be expended and accounted for as provided by 3 U.S.C. 105, 109, 110, and 112–114.
